name: USB Hub Support
author: NachoCasta
summary: Experimental candidate: HUB source badges and updated eject selector.
description: UI candidate awaiting validation: HUB / USB labels in Source and Browse, H badges in Waveform, and a matching Eject USB selector. Select Link mode before loading: On/Off briefly disconnects hub sources and can leave warnings. Four local decks with Link off; two with external Link on. Hub libraries stay local. Short-press USB STOP to select a stick; hold to eject the hub. Wait for safe-to-remove confirmation. Limited native cache. Exact firmware2.00 only. Actual-CDJ, phase-sync, eight-source hardware and long-session use remain unvalidated.
